description: PROVIDER: list the GPU nodes this account provides (needs a key with the 'nodes' scope). For each node: state (available, rented, paused, not_verified, not_ready, offline), GPUs and VRAM, price (default, allowed min/max, custom, what a renter pays), verification, reputation, the current rental (never the renter), and live metrics from the last minute: per-GPU load %, temperature °C, power W and VRAM, plus host CPU and memory. Read-only.
name: list_my_nodes
